name: Fish-sauce houses
nameVi: Làng nghề nước mắm Phú Quốc
kicker: Wooden vats of Phú Quốc fish sauce
summary: Barrel house: walk the wooden vats where Phú Quốc fish sauce ages for about a year. The vats are about 3 m across and hold 14–17 tons. The bureau’s output is over 10 million litres a year, and the district account says about 6 million. The association’s nitrogen range is 20–43 gN/lít. Go in the morning and pair the stop with a pepper garden.
getThere: The old houses sat by the Dương Đông river
heroCaption: Red wooden vats in a Phú Quốc fish-sauce house, with light at the far door
body: Walk a barrel house and look down the rows of wooden vats. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says the craft is over 200 years old, the first draw comes after about a year, the vats are 3 m across and hold 14–17 tons, and the salt ratio is 3 tons of fish to 1 ton of salt. The catch season on that page is April–November, when the anchovy schools come inshore. One workshop ages cá cơm than for 15 months to 43 percent nitrogen. Output on that page is over 10 million litres a year, from about 100 producers. The old pattern was family houses along the Dương Đông river so boats could land.

The figures disagree, and each one stays. The district account says output is about 6 million litres a year and nitrogen is trên 25ºC. Hội nước mắm Phú Quốc says a dark cockroach-wing colour, salty and deeply sweet, nitrogen 20–43 gN/lít, and up to 40°N in the introduction, with a salt ratio of 2.5–3 fish to 1 salt, aged 12 months, from the Gulf of Thailand. The association says fermenting and bottling happen inside the old huyện Phú Quốc. National geographical indication came in 2001, and European protection on 8 October 2012. A house name is a workshop, and the visit is the vats.

figures.caption: Unpainted wooden vats bound with rope in a Phú Quốc barrel house
figures.alt: Rows of wooden fish-sauce vats bound with rope on Phu Quoc

gettingThere: The bureau says the old houses sat along the Dương Đông river so boats could land. Ask in Dương Đông for a barrel house that lets you walk the vats, and keep the morning free so the pepper garden can follow.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: The historical houses were on the river in town. Pair the vats with the pepper gardens the whisper account puts on the same morning.

admissionNote: Nitrogen: 43 percent at one workshop on the bureau page, trên 25ºC on the district account, and 20–43 gN/lít at the association, which also says up to 40°N in its introduction. Output is over 10 million litres on the bureau page and about 6 million on the district page.
